interpretation_references.author: Nathan Long, Magic Rules NetRep
interpretation_references.scope: Entry look-ahead does not count the incoming object in battlefield population or devotion
Starfield of Nyx interaction notes; current wording is bound separately to the catalog
Ruby, Daring Tracker checks the power threshold when declared as an attacker, without repeating it on resolution; represented as an occurrence-only predicate.

Omo printed entry/attack target clauses and counter-dependent land and nonland-creature subtype grants; current subtype sets are bound to the pinned Comprehensive Rules. Talon Gates of Madara's optional creature phasing, both mana abilities and revealed hand activation; Desert Warfare's sacrifice/hand/library observations, exact delayed returns, combat threshold and noncopiable haste. Wonderscape Sage uses the returned land's last battlefield subtypes, including copies and Omo's everything counters, rather than its Basic supertype. Jyoti counts commander casts including countered spells and multiple commanders; combat power is captured once at resolution.
Xenagos combined red/green devotion counts a hybrid symbol once; battlefield-only creature-status effect and combat power capture.

Shock-land life payment preserves other tapped-entry instructions; entry-land printed-face review. Thespian's Stage retains its copy activation, preserves tap state, and applies no entry counters or entry triggers.
Reveal-land subtypes, simultaneous hand entry and other tapped-entry instructions; entry-land printed-face review.

Evoke alternative costs, reductions and controller changes; Mulldrifter and lark printed-face review. Ram Through rechecks both targets and deals simultaneous excess damage using marked damage and deathtouch while ignoring prevention and indestructible for lethal assignment.
Vesperlark printed behavior and the priority window before evoke sacrifice.
Oblivion Ring's separate exile/return triggers, early departure, and Aura entry on return; linked-exile draft conformance.

interpretation_references.author: Nathan Long, Wizards.Com Boards NetRep
interpretation_references.scope: Animate Dead cannot attach to a returned noncreature God; the Aura falls off and its delayed ability sacrifices that permanent. Protection remains outside this implementation's supported scope.
Fling requires exactly one creature sacrifice, uses its last battlefield power, and allows responses only after the full casting cost is paid.

Crop Rotation requires exactly one land sacrifice as an additional casting cost. Dark Depths has no mana ability; its no-ice state trigger cannot duplicate while waiting, can retrigger after being countered, and requires a successful sacrifice to create Marit Lage. Mystic Remora's cumulative upkeep increases with actual age counters and requires an optional complete payment.
Escape permission, alternative payment, repeated escape and Uro's independent entry benefit and optional land placement.
Bulk Up's power snapshot and Prayer of Binding's optional targeting, early source departure and Aura return.
The Ozolith departure copies, optional all-counter transfer, exact source and target availability.
Aven Courier chooses targets at trigger placement and counter kinds during resolution.
Essence Channeler's printed 2/1 body, gross turn life loss, one trigger per life-gain event, all-kind death snapshot and independent departure copies.

Xolatoyac's printed 6/6 body, targeted flood counter and source-independent Island duration; intrinsic Island mana and retained types. Volatile Fault's complete costs, optional opponent search even if destruction fails, Treasure creation and all-illegal-target resolution rule.
Counter-conditioned durations can begin at a new resolution after an earlier flood-counter condition ended.
The Earth Crystal's green generic reduction, replacement-aware +1/+1 doubling including entry, positive target division during announcement, and lost illegal-target shares.
Touch the Spirit Realm's optional entry exile, Channel discard cost, exact delayed owner return, token disappearance and early source departure.
Sigarda's Splendor's entry life note, resolution-time comparison and unconditional update after its upkeep ability.
Midnight Snack checks the entire turn's declared attacks even if its source entered later; its life-gain amount is evaluated when the activated ability resolves.

Official Baldur's Gate face inspected 2026-09-14: no tapped-entry clause, colorless base mana, unchanged other-Gates variable ability. Corrects the stored source, catalog and reviewed program; see MANA_CONVOKE_CARD_REVIEW.md.
Scute Swarm token-copy values, retained landfall and last known source after departure.
Helm of the Host's copiable nonlegendary exception, separate haste and different results when the equipped creature or Helm leaves.
Mirage Mirror: frozen copiable values, multiple activations, cleanup, independent effects, summoning and attachments.
March from Velis Vel: nonbasic land-type choice, current controlled recipients, copying without re-entry, separate haste and flashback.
Fangs of Kalonia's nontargeted overload and replacement-aware doubling; Fanatic of Rhonas's 1/4 body, ferocious activation restriction and eternalize copy exceptions.
Hydra Broodmaster's actual {4}{G}{G} cost, 7/7 body, monstrous transition and trigger X captured from the activation.
Official English Finale of Revelation face: alternate X>=10 resolution, untap up to five lands without a controller restriction, no maximum hand size for the rest of the game, then exile itself.
